instruction: Change the display name to 'Demo User' in the Thunderbird account setup form.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Thunderbird, navigated to Account Setup form, filled name as 'Anonym User', email as 'anonym-x2024@outlook.com', and password. Stayed on setup page but never clicked Continue, so IMAP was never shown. Evaluator expected 'Anonym Tester' not 'Anonym User'.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with Thunderbird UI, click form fields, clear and type text, fill name/email/password fields, switch between windows
metadata.failure_analysis: Model typed 'Anonym User' instead of expected 'Anonym Tester' for the name. Also never clicked Continue so IMAP protocol info was not displayed. The 4-xpath evaluator required all conditions including IMAP visibility.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to single-step: just fill the name field. Model demonstrated ability to clear and type in the name field successfully.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing display name in Thunderbird account setup form. Evaluator checks accessibility tree for 'Demo User' text presence.

scoring_breakdown.name_filled: 1.0 - Display name 'Demo User' present in accessibility tree

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_accessibility_tree) correctly extracts the full accessibility tree XML, which will contain the display name field value.
Metric (check_accessibility_tree) correctly parses the XML and evaluates the XPath rule, returning 1.0 if matching elements are found.
XPath '//application[@name='Thunderbird']//*[contains(text(), 'Demo User') or contains(@name, 'Demo User')]' correctly checks for the presence of 'Demo User' text in the Thunderbird UI.
Data flow is correct: get_rule returns List[Dict] matching check_accessibility_tree's expected rules parameter type.
Single-step instruction with single verification check provides complete coverage.
Minor: XPath checks anywhere in the Thunderbird application rather than specifically the name input field, which is slightly broad but practically sufficient for this task.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally narrow the XPath to target the specific name input field (e.g., //entry[@name='Your name'] with text check) for more precise verification.
